title: 특별검사후보추천위원회의 구성 및 운영 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 특별검사후보추천위원회의 구성 및 운영 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Composition of the Committee)
(1) The Speaker of the National Assembly shall establish a Special Prosecutor Candidate Recommendation Committee (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee") where the plenary session resolves that an investigation by a special prosecutor is necessary or where notification is received from the Minister of Justice.
(2) The four Committee members recommended by the National Assembly under Article 4 (4) 4 of the Act on the Appointment, etc. of Special Prosecutors (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") shall be appointed or commissioned by the Speaker of the National Assembly upon recommendation by negotiating groups: two shall be recommended by the largest negotiating group and two by the other negotiating groups. However, where the person subject to investigation under Article 2 of the Act is related to any of the following persons, the negotiating group of the political party to which the President belongs or belonged shall be excluded: <Amended on Nov. 28, 2024>
1. The President;
2. A member of the President's family (meaning a family member under Article 779 of the Civil Act; Article 779 (2) thereof shall not apply in such cases).
(3) Where fewer than two negotiating groups are eligible to make recommendations under paragraph (2), the eligible negotiating group shall recommend two members, and each of the two non-negotiating groups with the largest numbers of affiliated members of the National Assembly shall recommend one member. Where non-negotiating groups have equal numbers of members, the group that includes a member of the National Assembly with more terms of service shall be entitled to recommend; where the numbers of terms are also equal, the group that includes an older member of the National Assembly shall be entitled to recommend. <Newly Inserted on Nov. 28, 2024>
(4) Where only one non-negotiating group is eligible to make a recommendation under paragraph (3), the negotiating group eligible under paragraph (2) shall recommend two members, the non-negotiating group shall recommend one member, and the Speaker of the National Assembly shall recommend one member after consulting the floor leaders of each negotiating group. Where no non-negotiating group is eligible under paragraph (3), the eligible negotiating group shall recommend two members and the Speaker of the National Assembly shall recommend two members after consulting the floor leaders of each negotiating group. <Newly Inserted on Nov. 28, 2024>
(5) To obtain recommendations for Committee members, the Speaker of the National Assembly shall request in writing that the negotiating groups under paragraph (2) (including non-negotiating groups in cases under paragraphs (3) and (4); hereinafter the same shall apply in this Article) recommend members within a period specified by the Speaker that does not exceed five days; each group shall complete its recommendations within the prescribed period. <Newly Inserted on Nov. 28, 2024>
(6) Notwithstanding paragraph (5), where a negotiating group fails to recommend members within the prescribed period, the Speaker of the National Assembly shall make the recommendations. <Newly Inserted on Nov. 28, 2024>
